# Hugo Editor

> A local-first markdown editor for Hugo blogs, with writing agents. It runs in the browser against folders on the user's own machine; the Cloudflare Worker serves the app and the agent API.

This is a single-user tool. There is no public content to read or index here.

## Routes

- `/`: the editor (a single-page app; every other path serves it too).
- `/api/health`: unauthenticated status, including the deployed commit.
- `/api/reports`: the browser report collector (CSP, Reporting API, Web Vitals). Write-only.
- `/api/*` (everything else): the agent API. Needs the editor token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`).

## Agents and tools

The editor exposes its own tools to in-browser agents through WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext`) where the browser supports it. There is no public API for outside agents.
